description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.16.2 is a feature release for macOS and Windows on top of 0.16.1.
New
- Start a mission without a crew. The redesigned Start mission dialog adds No crew: the mission opens empty, and you add roles in place, each with its own task. Members receive the goal, broadcast or message each other directly, and ask you their questions without going through a lead. Messaging turns on once the first member joins. Starting from a crew works as before, and deleting a crew now keeps the missions it started. (#849, #906)
- A start page when nothing is open. Closing or archiving the chat or terminal you are viewing now leaves the window on a start page with New chat, New terminal and New mission, each showing your current shortcut. An empty pane in a split tab offers New chat and New terminal for that pane. (#853, #901)
Bug fixes
- Claude chats in folders with underscores, spaces or non-ASCII names resume after a restart. Runner looked for these chats' saved conversations in the wrong place, so after an update or restart they were not resumed automatically, and Resume opened a blank conversation. Runner now finds them, including folders with very long paths. If a chat already reopened blank, run /resume in it and pick the earlier conversation. (#909, #910)
- Mission messages no longer interrupt a member's first turn. Each member, including a crew's lead, receives messages only after its first turn ends, so a worker's report during the lead's planning turn arrives afterwards instead of being typed into it. (#906)
- Archiving the mission you are viewing returns to the start page. Your saved chat tabs stay, and the Archiving progress pill shows without the Resume / Archive panel flashing up. (#906)
- New chat always opens on Direct chat. It no longer remembers Role chat from last time. Role chat is one click away, with the last focused role still preselected. (#905)
